name: Hrökkáll
body:
HRÖKKÁLL
CR 3

A yard-long, corpse-slick eel, sheathed in thick scales and with sharp jagged lateral fins along its sides. Its body glistens with a dark slimy sheen.

XP 800
NE Small aberration
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 12, flat-footed 17 (+1 Dex, +6 natural, +1 size)
hp 26 (4d8+8)
Fort +5, Ref +2, Will +4; (+2 vs. mind–affecting effects)
Defensive Abilities acidic slime, negative energy affinity, resist level drain; Immune disease, poison

OFFENSE

Speed 5 ft., swim 30 ft.
Melee slam +7 (1d6+4 plus grab)
Special Attacks constrict (1d6+4 slashing plus acidic slime plus 1d4 bleed), grab (Large or smaller), poison, saw-toothed fins

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 12, Con 15, Int 1, Wis 10, Cha 6
Base Atk +2; CMB +4 (+8 grapple); CMD 15
Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative
Skills Escape Artist +13, Perception +6, Stealth +9, Swim +15; Racial Modifiers +8 Escape Artist, +2 Perception
SQ amphibious

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Acidic Slime (Ex)

The hrökkáll exudes an acidic toxic slime. Any creature that strikes a hrökkáll with a natural attack or unarmed strike takes 1d6 points of acid damage from this slime if it fails a DC 14 Reflex save. A creature that strikes a hrökkáll with a melee weapon must make a DC 14 Reflex save or the weapon takes 1d6 points of acid damage. This acid is particularly corrosive and this damage ignores hardness of 8 or less. When a hrökkáll makes a successful grapple check, the creature it is grappling automatically takes 1d6 points of acid damage. A creature which takes acid damage from acidic slime is exposed to hrökkáll toxin.

The save DC is Constitution-based.

Poison (Ex)

Hrökkáll Toxin—contact; save Fort DC 14; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d2 Con; cure 1 save. The hrökkáll is completely inedible and anyone who swallows it whole or attempts to consume its flesh is exposed to this poison. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Resist Level Drain (Ex)

A hrökkáll takes no penalties from energy draining effects, though it can still be killed if it accrues more negative levels than it has Hit Dice. After 24 hours, any negative levels are removed without the need for an additional saving throw.

Saw-Toothed Fins (Ex)

Razor sharp saw-like fins run along the hrökkáll’s sides. The hrökkáll’s constrict attack deals slashing damage and also deals 1d4 bleed damage.

ECOLOGY

Environment fresh water
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

Long ago a spiteful necromancer called on foul magics to revive the decomposing corpse of a toxic eel, and thus spawned the first hrökkáll. Although their creator has long since perished, the hrökkáll bred and multiplied. Known as “coil-eels”, these creatures are unnatural things born of decay and corruption. Their descendants now haunt stagnant waters, still ponds, and sluggish rivers.

The hrökkáll has flexible yet iron-hard scales, with razor-sharp saw-toothed fins running down its sides. It secretes potent corrosive venom and a captured hrökkáll can even dissolve earth or rock to squirm back into the water. A hrökkáll ambushes its victims by lurking unseen below the water’s surface then wrapping tightly around their legs. While hrökkálls are known to attack humanoids and horses, there are persistent yet incorrect folk stories that wrongly claim sheep are safe because their legs are too slender for a hrökkáll to grasp.
